properties.name: spring.ai.typesafe.api-key
properties.description: TypeSafe API key. No Jev client is auto-configured until it is set.

properties.name: spring.ai.typesafe.openjev-api-key
properties.description: OpenJEV API key — a free community gateway to the same Jev model. When set and no TypeSafe key is configured, the client uses OpenJEV automatically.

properties.name: spring.ai.typesafe.provider
properties.description: Explicit provider selection: 'openjev' or 'typesafe'. When unset the provider is auto-detected — TypeSafe wins if its key is set, otherwise OpenJEV.

properties.name: spring.ai.typesafe.base-url
properties.description: API root of the TypeSafe System One service.

properties.name: spring.ai.typesafe.model
properties.description: Model name or alias applied to requests that do not name one.

values.description: Use the TypeSafe AI API directly (default when its key is set).
